trigger.description: A client sends ee.daemon.search or ee.daemon.context with failIfWarming=true while the daemon startup search warm-up is still in flight (warm.posture == "warming"). The daemon refuses the request in 1 RTT with DAEMON_WARMING_CODE so the CLI falls back immediately to canonical local retrieval without waiting for warm-up or issuing a separate capabilities round-trip.

message_contains: daemon search stack is still warming
